proposal.observation: Parent NaFadeNet 3-split MAPE 0.1690 ± 0.0420. Its late-prefix error stays high (prefix 51-100 MAPE 0.13-0.20; late bias -17 to -29 cycles) and predictions are compressed on split 42 (spread 0.47). Non-learning diagnostic: a masked least-squares line on the last 20 observed discharge capacities (capacity/nominal), extended to the EOL threshold 0.8, gives val MAPE 0.04-0.11 on prefixes 51-100 on all three splits but 2.5-4.7 on prefixes 1-10. The network and the extrapolation are complementary.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: A learned gate that mixes the NaFadeNet output with a parameter-free fade extrapolation (gate inputs: prefix fraction, extrapolated EOL, slope, fit residual) will rely on the network early and on the extrapolation late, cutting late-prefix MAPE and the extreme-EOL compression.
proposal.question_inherited: Can the model use the direct physical crossing estimate where it is reliable?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Late-prefix error and compression of NaFadeNet.
proposal.why_this_experiment: Confirmation of NA-E006 (Codex APPROVE) on paper split 2024; only split and seed change.
proposal.modification: NaFadeNet (unchanged) + gated extrapolation head: est = masked line fit on last 20 observed q_d (cycles), crossing 0.8, clamped [n+1, 600] (no gradient); g = sigmoid(MLP 4->16->1 on [n/100, est/100, 1000*slope, 100*resid]) with output bias init -2; z_ext = a*est/100 + c (learned, init a=2, c=-3.6); y = (1-g)*y_net + g*z_ext. +99 params.
proposal.changed_components: Head only (adds the gated extrapolation path); NaFadeNet body unchanged.
proposal.held_constant_components: NaFadeNet config, split 2021, seed 2021, Relative Huber 0.15, Adam 5e-5, batch 128, max 100 / min 5 epochs, patience 5, checkpoint rule, data, masks.
proposal.controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: Split-2021 MAPE/RMSE/Acc@15 vs NA-E003; prefix-group MAPE; mean gate value per prefix group; per-cell errors.
proposal.rejection_condition: Confirmation run; KEEP the direction if the 3-split mean beats parent NaFadeNet 0.1690 by >= 0.008.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; CPMLP block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.

architecture_addendum.mechanism: gated mixture of the network prediction and a masked fade-extrapolation estimate
architecture_addendum.shapes: curves [B,100,3,300], mask [B,100] -> NaFadeNet y_net [B]; q_d [B,100] (x mask) -> masked line fit on last 20 observed -> est, slope, resid [B] -> feats [B,4] -> gate MLP -> g [B]; z_ext [B]; y [B]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: q_d is multiplied by mask; the fit weights are mask * (t > n-20), so padded cycles have weight 0; n = mask.sum; est clamped to >= n+1; unit test: changing padded cycles changes the output by 0.0.
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: vs parent NA-E003 on split 2021 (MAPE 0.1234, RMSE 29.0, Acc@15 0.642; DB-MAPE = MAPE): lower MAPE/RMSE, prefix 51-100 MAPE below 0.10, gate value rising with prefix length, bias closer to 0.
